notes: luna: It names works, love, faith, service, and patient endurance among the congregation’s qualities.
terra: It commends works, love, service, faith, and patience together, closely echoing the linked qualities in the ayah.

text.KJV: I know thy works, and charity, and service, and faith, and thy patience, and thy works; and the last [to be] more than the first.
text.SBLGNT: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, καὶ τὴν ⸂ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν⸃ καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων.

notes: luna: It describes the saints as keeping God’s commandments, holding faith in Jesus, and showing patience.
terra: It identifies the saints by patience, obedience to God's commandments, and faith in Jesus, closely paralleling belief, righteous action, and perseverance.

text.KJV: Here is the patience of the saints: here [are] they that keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.
text.SBLGNT: Ὧδε ἡ ὑπομονὴ τῶν ἁγίων ἐστίν, οἱ τηροῦντες τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν πίστιν Ἰησοῦ.

notes: luna: It urges believers to stir one another toward love and good works.
terra: It commands mutual consideration that spurs love and good works.

text.KJV: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
text.SBLGNT: καὶ κατανοῶμεν ἀλλήλους εἰς παροξυσμὸν ἀγάπης καὶ καλῶν ἔργων,

notes: luna: It says Abraham’s faith worked together with his deeds and was brought to completion by them.
terra: It says faith worked together with works and was completed by them, directly joining belief and action.

text.KJV: Seest thou how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
text.SBLGNT: βλέπεις ὅτι ἡ πίστις συνήργει τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἔργων ἡ πίστις ἐτελειώθη,

notes: luna: It tells the community to admonish and encourage one another, help the weak, and be patient with all.
terra: It calls the brethren to warn, comfort, support, and be patient toward all.

text.KJV: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all [men].
text.SBLGNT: παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους, παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους, ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν, μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας.

notes: luna: It says love should be expressed in deed and truth rather than words alone.
terra: It commands love in deed and truth rather than merely in word.

text.KJV: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
text.SBLGNT: ⸀Τεκνία, μὴ ἀγαπῶμεν λόγῳ μηδὲ τῇ γλώσσῃ ἀλλὰ ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

notes: luna: It commands preaching, correction, and exhortation with patience and teaching.
terra: It commands exhortation grounded in the word and doctrine with all longsuffering.

text.KJV: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
text.SBLGNT: κήρυξον τὸν λόγον, ἐπίστηθι εὐκαίρως ἀκαίρως, ἔλεγξον, ἐπιτίμησον, παρακάλεσον, ἐν πάσῃ μακροθυμίᾳ καὶ διδαχῇ.

notes: luna: It describes believers as able to instruct one another.
terra: It joins goodness and knowledge with the ability to admonish one another.

text.KJV: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
text.SBLGNT: Πέπεισμαι δέ, ἀδελφοί μου, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐγὼ περὶ ὑμῶν, ὅτι καὶ αὐτοὶ μεστοί ἐστε ἀγαθωσύνης, πεπληρωμένοι ⸀πάσης γνώσεως, δυνάμενοι καὶ ⸀ἀλλήλους νουθετεῖν.

notes: luna: It connects patient persistence in doing good with the hope of eternal life.
terra: It promises eternal life to those who persist patiently in doing good.

text.KJV: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
text.SBLGNT: τοῖς μὲν καθʼ ὑπομονὴν ἔργου ἀγαθοῦ δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν ζητοῦσιν ζωὴν αἰώνιον·

notes: luna: It urges imitation of those who inherit the promises through faith and patience.
terra: It says that the promises are inherited through faith and patience.

text.KJV: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
text.SBLGNT: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε, μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας.

notes: luna: It joins trusting in the Lord with doing good.
terra: It directly pairs trusting the LORD with doing good and receiving his provision.

text.KJV: Trust in the LORD, and do good; [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
text.WLC: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃

notes: luna: It says those who hold fast to the word bear fruit with patience.
terra: It describes people who keep the heard word and bear fruit with patience, joining truth received, faithful action, and endurance.

text.KJV: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep [it], and bring forth fruit with patience.
text.SBLGNT: τὸ δὲ ἐν τῇ καλῇ γῇ, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἵτινες ἐν καρδίᾳ καλῇ καὶ ἀγαθῇ ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον κατέχουσιν καὶ καρποφοροῦσιν ἐν ὑπομονῇ.

notes: luna: It says the disciples were exhorted to continue in the faith and endure tribulations.
terra: It exhorts disciples to continue in faith through tribulation in order to enter God's kingdom.

text.KJV: Confirming the souls of the disciples, [and] exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.
text.SBLGNT: ἐπιστηρίζοντες τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν μαθητῶν, παρακαλοῦντες ἐμμένειν τῇ πίστει καὶ ὅτι διὰ πολλῶν θλίψεων δεῖ ἡμᾶς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.

notes: luna: It urges persistence in doing good rather than growing weary.
terra: It promises reaping to those who do good without becoming weary.

text.KJV: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
text.SBLGNT: τὸ δὲ καλὸν ποιοῦντες μὴ ⸀ἐγκακῶμεν, καιρῷ γὰρ ἰδίῳ θερίσομεν μὴ ἐκλυόμενοι.

notes: luna: It joins obedience to the truth with fervent love for one another.
terra: It joins obedience to truth with fervent reciprocal love among believers.

text.KJV: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, [see that ye] love one another with a pure heart fervently:
text.SBLGNT: Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ⸀ἀληθείας εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον ⸀ἐκ καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἀγαπήσατε ἐκτενῶς,

notes: luna: It calls believers steadfast and says to abound in the Lord’s work.
terra: It calls believers to steadfastness and abundant work because their labor is not vain.

text.KJV: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
text.SBLGNT: Ὥστε, ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί, ἑδραῖοι γίνεσθε, ἀμετακίνητοι, περισσεύοντες ἐν τῷ ἔργῳ τοῦ κυρίου πάντοτε, εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ κόπος ὑμῶν οὐκ ἔστιν κενὸς ἐν κυρίῳ.

notes: terra: It asks whether claimed faith without works can save, making faith joined to deeds decisive against loss.

text.KJV: What [doth it] profit, my brethren, though a man say he hath faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
text.SBLGNT: ⸀Τί ὄφελος, ἀδελφοί μου, ἐὰν πίστιν λέγῃ τις ἔχειν ἔργα δὲ μὴ ἔχῃ; μὴ δύναται ἡ πίστις σῶσαι αὐτόν;

notes: terra: It calls faith without works dead, matching the ayah's union of belief and righteous deeds.

text.KJV: Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.
text.SBLGNT: οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις, ἐὰν μὴ ⸂ἔχῃ ἔργα⸃, νεκρά ἐστιν καθʼ ἑαυτήν.

notes: terra: It compares faith without works to a dead body, sharply affirming that faith must have active expression.

text.KJV: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
text.SBLGNT: ὥσπερ ⸀γὰρ τὸ σῶμα χωρὶς πνεύματος νεκρόν ἐστιν, οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις ⸀χωρὶς ἔργων νεκρά ἐστιν.

notes: terra: It rejects professed fellowship with God that walks in darkness as a lie and a failure to do the truth.

text.KJV: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
text.SBLGNT: ἐὰν εἴπωμεν ὅτι κοινωνίαν ἔχομεν μετʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ σκότει περιπατῶμεν, ψευδόμεθα καὶ οὐ ποιοῦμεν τὴν ἀλήθειαν·

notes: terra: It contrasts mere hearers with doers of God's law who are justified, paralleling true adherence joined to action.

text.KJV: (For not the hearers of the law [are] just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
text.SBLGNT: οὐ γὰρ οἱ ἀκροαταὶ ⸀νόμου δίκαιοι παρὰ ⸀τῷ θεῷ, ἀλλʼ οἱ ποιηταὶ ⸁νόμου δικαιωθήσονται.

notes: terra: It joins patience and doing God's will with receiving the promise.

text.KJV: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of God, ye might receive the promise.
text.SBLGNT: ὑπομονῆς γὰρ ἔχετε χρείαν ἵνα τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ ποιήσαντες κομίσησθε τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν·

notes: terra: It joins persistence in sound teaching with salvation for both the teacher and those who hear.

text.KJV: Take heed unto thyself, and unto the doctrine; continue in them: for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself, and them that hear thee.
text.SBLGNT: ἔπεχε σεαυτῷ καὶ τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ· ἐπίμενε αὐτοῖς· τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν καὶ σεαυτὸν σώσεις καὶ τοὺς ἀκούοντάς σου.

notes: terra: It makes salvation depend on holding fast the preached message rather than having believed in vain.

text.KJV: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
text.SBLGNT: διʼ οὗ καὶ σῴζεσθε, τίνι λόγῳ εὐηγγελισάμην ὑμῖν, εἰ κατέχετε, ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ εἰκῇ ἐπιστεύσατε.

notes: terra: It excludes mere profession and admits into the kingdom those who do the Father's will.

text.KJV: ¶ Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
text.SBLGNT: Οὐ πᾶς ὁ λέγων μοι· Κύριε κύριε εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἀλλʼ ὁ ποιῶν τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πατρός μου τοῦ ἐν ⸀τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

notes: terra: It makes sharing in Christ conditional on holding initial confidence steadfast to the end.

text.KJV: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
text.SBLGNT: μέτοχοι γὰρ ⸂τοῦ Χριστοῦ γεγόναμεν⸃, ἐάνπερ τὴν ἀρχὴν τῆς ὑποστάσεως μέχρι τέλους βεβαίαν κατάσχωμεν.

notes: terra: It directs sufferers to entrust themselves to God while continuing in well-doing.

text.KJV: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls [to him] in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
text.SBLGNT: ὥστε καὶ οἱ πάσχοντες κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ ⸀θεοῦ πιστῷ κτίστῃ παρατιθέσθωσαν τὰς ψυχὰς ⸀αὐτῶν ἐν ἀγαθοποιΐᾳ.

notes: terra: It commends works, labor, patience, and discerning false apostles as liars.

text.KJV: I know thy works, and thy labour, and thy patience, and how thou canst not bear them which are evil: and thou hast tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and hast found them liars:
text.SBLGNT: Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου, καὶ τὸν ⸀κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς, καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ἀποστόλους, καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς·

notes: terra: It joins loving, obeying, and cleaving to God with life itself.

text.KJV: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, [and] that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he [is] thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

notes: terra: It commands turning to God, keeping justice, and waiting on God continually.

text.KJV: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.

notes: terra: It joins seeking God's law, doing it, and teaching it to others.

text.KJV: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do [it], and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

notes: terra: It joins truth in speech, upright conduct, and turning many away from iniquity.

text.KJV: The law of truth was in his mouth, and iniquity was not found in his lips: he walked with me in peace and equity, and did turn many away from iniquity.
text.WLC: תּוֹרַ֤ת אֱמֶת֙ הָיְתָ֣ה בְּפִ֔יהוּ וְעַוְלָ֖ה לֹא־נִמְצָ֣א בִשְׂפָתָ֑יו בְּשָׁל֤וֹם וּבְמִישׁוֹר֙ הָלַ֣ךְ אִתִּ֔י וְרַבִּ֖ים הֵשִׁ֥יב מֵעָוֺֽן׃

notes: terra: It tells hearers to wait on the LORD and keep his way, promising inheritance while the wicked are cut off.

text.KJV: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].

notes: terra: It explicitly joins hope for God's salvation with doing his commandments.

text.KJV: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

notes: terra: It calls for sowing righteousness, seeking the LORD, and receiving his merciful righteousness.

text.KJV: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for [it is] time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
text.WLC: זִרְע֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לִצְדָקָה֙ קִצְר֣וּ לְפִי־חֶ֔סֶד נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְעֵת֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהוָ֔ה עַד־יָב֕וֹא וְיֹרֶ֥ה צֶ֖דֶק לָכֶֽם׃

notes: terra: It rejects calling Jesus Lord without doing what he says, matching the demand that belief be enacted.

text.KJV: ¶ And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
text.SBLGNT: Τί δέ με καλεῖτε· Κύριε κύριε, καὶ οὐ ποιεῖτε ἃ λέγω;

notes: terra: It calls the persistent hearer a doer and promises that he will be blessed in his deed.

text.KJV: But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth [therein], he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
text.SBLGNT: ὁ δὲ παρακύψας εἰς νόμον τέλειον τὸν τῆς ἐλευθερίας καὶ παραμείνας, ⸀οὐκ ἀκροατὴς ἐπιλησμονῆς γενόμενος ἀλλὰ ποιητὴς ἔργου, οὗτος μακάριος ἐν τῇ ποιήσει αὐτοῦ ἔσται.

notes: luna: It calls believers to encourage one another as they gather.
terra: It commands believers to exhort one another as the day approaches.

text.KJV: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some [is]; but exhorting [one another]: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
text.SBLGNT: μὴ ἐγκαταλείποντες τὴν ἐπισυναγωγὴν ἑαυτῶν, καθὼς ἔθος τισίν, ἀλλὰ παρακαλοῦντες, καὶ τοσούτῳ μᾶλλον ὅσῳ βλέπετε ἐγγίζουσαν τὴν ἡμέραν.

notes: luna: It tells believers to exhort one another daily so none is hardened by sin’s deceit.
terra: It commands daily mutual exhortation so that none is hardened by sin's deceitfulness.

text.KJV: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
text.SBLGNT: ἀλλὰ παρακαλεῖτε ἑαυτοὺς καθʼ ἑκάστην ἡμέραν, ἄχρις οὗ τὸ Σήμερον καλεῖται, ἵνα μὴ σκληρυνθῇ ⸂τις ἐξ ὑμῶν⸃ ἀπάτῃ τῆς ἁμαρτίας·

notes: luna: It says to teach and admonish one another with the word of Christ.
terra: It commands believers to teach and admonish one another with Christ's word.

text.KJV: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
text.SBLGNT: ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν πλουσίως ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ· διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ⸀ψαλμοῖς, ⸀ὕμνοις, ᾠδαῖς πνευματικαῖς ⸀ἐν χάριτι, ᾄδοντες ἐν ⸂ταῖς καρδίαις⸃ ὑμῶν τῷ ⸀θεῷ·

notes: luna: It commands people to speak truth with their neighbors as members of one another.

text.KJV: Blessed [is] the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him.
text.SBLGNT: Μακάριος ἀνὴρ ὃς ὑπομένει πειρασμόν, ὅτι δόκιμος γενόμενος λήμψεται τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς, ὃν ⸀ἐπηγγείλατο τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν.

notes: terra: It uses the farmer's waiting for precious fruit as an image of patient endurance.

text.KJV: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
text.SBLGNT: Μακροθυμήσατε οὖν, ἀδελφοί, ἕως τῆς παρουσίας τοῦ κυρίου. ἰδοὺ ὁ γεωργὸς ἐκδέχεται τὸν τίμιον καρπὸν τῆς γῆς, μακροθυμῶν ἐπʼ ⸀αὐτῷ ἕως ⸀λάβῃ πρόϊμον καὶ ὄψιμον.

notes: terra: It presents the prophets as examples of suffering and patience.

text.KJV: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
text.SBLGNT: ὑπόδειγμα λάβετε, ⸀ἀδελφοί, τῆς κακοπαθίας καὶ τῆς μακροθυμίας τοὺς προφήτας, οἳ ἐλάλησαν ⸀ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου.

notes: terra: It calls those who endure blessed and invokes Job's patience.

text.KJV: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
text.SBLGNT: ἰδοὺ μακαρίζομεν τοὺς ⸀ὑπομείναντας· τὴν ὑπομονὴν Ἰὼβ ἠκούσατε, καὶ τὸ τέλος κυρίου ⸀εἴδετε, ὅτι πολύσπλαγχνός ἐστιν ⸂ὁ κύριος⸃ καὶ οἰκτίρμων.

notes: terra: It commands steadfast resistance in faith amid sufferings shared by fellow believers.

text.KJV: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
text.SBLGNT: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν ⸀τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.

notes: terra: It calls for diligence to make one's calling sure and promises no fall when these virtues are practiced.

text.KJV: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:
text.SBLGNT: διὸ μᾶλλον, ἀδελφοί, σπουδάσατε βεβαίαν ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν ποιεῖσθαι· ταῦτα γὰρ ποιοῦντες οὐ μὴ πταίσητέ ποτε·

notes: terra: It makes keeping God's commandments the evidence of knowing him.

text.KJV: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
text.SBLGNT: Καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γινώσκομεν ὅτι ἐγνώκαμεν αὐτόν, ἐὰν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν.

notes: terra: It defines love for God as keeping his commandments.

text.KJV: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
text.SBLGNT: αὕτη γάρ ἐστιν ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ θεοῦ ἵνα τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ τηρῶμεν, καὶ αἱ ἐντολαὶ αὐτοῦ βαρεῖαι οὐκ εἰσίν,

notes: terra: It commands faithfulness unto death and promises the crown of life.

text.KJV: Fear none of those things which thou shalt suffer: behold, the devil shall cast [some] of you into prison, that ye may be tried; and ye shall have tribulation ten days: be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.
text.SBLGNT: ⸀μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις ⸀πάσχειν. ⸀ἰδοὺ μέλλει ⸀βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε, καὶ ⸀ἕξετε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα. γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου, καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς.

notes: terra: It identifies the faithful remnant by keeping God's commandments and holding Jesus's testimony.

text.KJV: And the dragon was wroth with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.
text.SBLGNT: καὶ ὠργίσθη ὁ δράκων ἐπὶ τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ποιῆσαι πόλεμον μετὰ τῶν λοιπῶν τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῆς, τῶν τηρούντων τὰς ἐντολὰς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐχόντων τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ·

notes: terra: It describes people turning their ears away from truth and turning instead to fables.

text.KJV: And they shall turn away [their] ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
text.SBLGNT: καὶ ἀπὸ μὲν τῆς ἀληθείας τὴν ἀκοὴν ἀποστρέψουσιν, ἐπὶ δὲ τοὺς μύθους ἐκτραπήσονται.

notes: terra: It depicts false prophecy and a people who welcome it, reversing communal commitment to truth.

text.KJV: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love [to have it] so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?
